## What's changed

- Adds direct LAN Companion Display support for compatible Tater Echo Show and Rook satellites, independent of Tater and Home Assistant.
- Discovers compatible screens automatically and adds a polished player-to-display selector under Tater Tube player settings, including online, offline, compatibility, and one-player-per-screen handling.
- Sends artwork, titles, series and episode details, playback progress, duration, and inferred play/pause state to the linked screen, with smooth progress interpolation, bounded leases, and automatic clearing when playback ends.
- Reuses the server's existing Activity and play-state data for companion screens, enriching active streams with media and artwork identity without requiring a Tater Tube Player or Tater Core protocol update.
- Consolidates video mode, hardware acceleration, resolution conversion, audio format, upscaling, HDR enhancement, and buffering details into consistent playback badges across the dashboard and Activity page.
- Makes the dashboard's Stop action fully terminate paired Tube TV playback, including its shared HLS session and protection against late playlist requests restarting it.
- Improves automatic Tube TV theme channels by preferring structured movie and series genres, loading series genres from local metadata, matching whole terms, and avoiding false cartoon or action matches from plot text and partial words.
